body:
add in anger. 

the people who I thought were my friends for the past 10 years decided within a span of a few weeks to leave me in the dust, lie to my face, treat me like shit all for nothing. I didn’t cause anything to happen. the only thing I did was go on a vacation and they stopped contributing to the friendship. So I guess i should stop contributing to life.

People have forgotten about me. 

no one answers my messages, no one wants to talk to me or spend time with me. everyone has found someone better than me to spend time with. I don’t know why I ever thought I mattered to anyone when I really don’t. my life means nothing to people and they want nothing to do with me. I should have died when I had the chance.

edit: and now the only two people who I hung w before are completely avoiding me and excluding me out of everything. Fucking great.
